messages.subject: Project Atlas - report on legal due diligence
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles, Miriam,

Our report on legal due diligence is attached. In short, nothing we have found should stop the deal, but there are six issues to manage: the EMI options (to be cleared pre-completion), the Sheffield rent review and two change-of-control consents on the leases, the Pulse equipment contract consent, a threatened manager grievance, a closed ICO matter, and the open HMRC VAT enquiry. We recommend covering the VAT point with a specific capped indemnity. Happy to walk you through it on a call.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
